messages:
ivan-sales: Quick thread: Prospect 'Arcadia Capital' requests BYO-KMS POC. Requirements: automated rotation demo, 72h pen-test window, throughput proof for 7k QPS, and explicit SOW language around key custody and rotation rollback. Can we scope?
petra-se: We need traffic profile (avg seq len, burst distribution) to size. Also confirm whether they require end-to-end test with their staging KEK or synthetic wrapped keys.
omar-crypto: Security stance: we will never hold plaintext KEKs. For demo with staging KEK we require customer to generate KEK in their HSM, provide only wrapped test material, and sign a thumbprint exchange (sha256). Rotation demo flow: client rotates KEK -> posts new wrapped-key thumbprint -> our rotation API validates signature + nonce -> cutover window starts.
lina-legal: SOW asks: add clause "No export of unencrypted key material" and define rotation rollback SLA (notification 15m, rollback window 30m). Also include pen-test liability cap and requirement for HSM attestation (FIPS mention optional when available).
noah-eng-ops: Perf: earliest slot Sun 01:00-03:00 UTC. We can run 7k QPS for 10m with warm caches. We'll collect p50/p95/p99 and CPU/token. Need their allowlist for our proxy IPs: 18.205.100.45/32 and 18.205.100.46/32. Preflight curl to check thumbprint endpoint: `curl -H "Authorization: Bearer <token>" https://kms-proxy.redwood.example.com/thumbprint`
ivan-sales: Arcadia prefers weekend window and insists on using staging KEK. Any compliance blockers?
omar-crypto: It's acceptable if they generate all KEKs inside their HSM and only hand back wrapped keys/thumbprints. We'll require signed nonce exchange and audit log entries for rotation events (actor, timestamp, key-id).
lina-legal: Also request indemnity carveout for pen-tests limited to POC scope and cap damages to 2x monthly SLA credit. Add contact list for incident notifications.
petra-se: Pricing: propose POC connector rate $95/hr (runtime) + optional $10k onboarding if they need us to manage proxy certs. I'll confirm with finance.
ci-bot: task-created: byo-kms-1809991234 (owner=noah-eng-ops) start=1809998400 due=1809999600
noah-eng-ops: Booked tentative slot for Sun; asking Ivan to confirm allowlist and wrapped-key deliverable by Fri EOD.
ivan-sales: Will confirm with Arcadia and send combined SOW + rotation spec + perf checklist by EOD Friday. Thanks everyone.
